rationale: Merge the duplicate AlphaGen and Alpha Generation, LLC production identities into one legal-company record. Alpha Generation, LLC is the legal name and AlphaGen is its operating name. Preserve ArcLight Capital Partners as the controlling majority owner, ADIA's 16.8% interest and CPP Investments' strategic minority interest. Correct CPP's investment date from its October 2025 announcement to the March 9, 2026 legal closing, preserve ADIA's May 23, 2025 equity close, and add current legal, regulatory and post-closing evidence. No AlphaGen owner-level exit or pending disposition was found through August 12, 2026.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count Alpha Generation, LLC once as the manager-level U.S. power-generation platform. Do not separately count its generation facilities, projects or upstream holding entities.

ownershipResolution.stake: Controlling majority interest; exact percentage not publicly disclosed
Strategic minority interest; at least 10% and less than 50%, with the exact percentage not publicly disclosed

exitSearch: No subsequent AlphaGen sale, ArcLight exit, ADIA exit or CPP exit was identified through August 12, 2026. DigitalBridge's May 2026 agreement to acquire the ArcLight manager is a conditional manager-level transaction and does not itself transfer AlphaGen ownership.
